'''Allen Divers Allen's Deck of Jabba's Madness''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on Decipher Deck Designs.

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Allen Divers]]
* '''Published:''' October 1998 (Decipher Deck Designs)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber|JP-L-jabbaspalaceaudiencechamber.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Allen's Deck of Jabba's Madness
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PJP Allen's Deck of Jabba's Madness Dive.txt |Download]]
